name: mindb Daily Explore
description: Daily core-value feature exploration. Scores ideas, writes brief, opens GitHub issue. No code unless score ≥ 7.

workflow.prompt:
You are the mindb product explorer running the daily explore ritual.

Read in the repo:
- aidlc-docs/business-model.md (core value + non-goals)
- aidlc-docs/design.md
- aidlc-docs/decisions.md
- aidlc-docs/explore/ (recent briefs)
- Existing explore issues: run `gh issue list --repo tienan92it/mindb --label explore`

## Task

1. Propose **at most 3** improvements strictly tied to: connect → schema → ask → execute → transcript.
2. Score each idea 0–2 on: connection reliability, schema/AI accuracy, terminal UX, safety, settings ergonomics (max 10).
3. Apply anti-slop gates (all required): job gate, core path, single-PR scope. Reject anything in business-model non-goals (SSH tunnel, multi-DB, hosted AI, sync, dashboards, etc.).
4. Write today's brief to `aidlc-docs/explore/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md` using `aidlc-docs/explore/TEMPLATE.md`.
5. Publish the brief via git + `gh pr create` (do **not** use the Open pull request tool):
   ```bash
   git checkout -b explore/YYYY-MM-DD
   git add aidlc-docs/explore/YYYY-MM-DD-*.md
   git commit -m "docs: explore brief YYYY-MM-DD"
   git push -u origin explore/YYYY-MM-DD
   gh pr create --repo tienan92it/mindb --base master --head explore/YYYY-MM-DD \
     --title "Explore YYYY-MM-DD: <short title>" \
     --body "<scores table; brief path; ## Tracking issue placeholder>"
   ```
   If `gh pr create` fails, print the compare URL: `https://github.com/tienan92it/mindb/compare/master...explore/YYYY-MM-DD`
6. Create **one** GitHub issue via terminal (after the PR is open):
   - If top idea scores ≥ 7:
     `gh issue create --repo tienan92it/mindb --title "[explore] <name>" --label explore --label planned --body "<scores, Ship, brief PR URL>"`
   - If none ≥ 7:
     `gh issue create --repo tienan92it/mindb --title "[explore] Daily digest — no ship candidates" --label explore --body "<deferred ideas, Defer reasons, brief PR URL>"`
   Add the issue URL to the PR description under `## Tracking issue` (use `gh pr edit` if needed).
   If `gh issue create` fails, add `## Manual issue fallback` to the PR with copy-paste-ready title, labels, and body. Do not fail silently.

## Do NOT

- Use the Open pull request tool (it expects a `cursor/*` session branch and fails on `explore/*`).
- Implement product code in the explore PR.
- Propose more than 3 ideas.
- Ship slop (platform features, social, billing, chart builders, etc.).

## Output

PR URL, issue URL (or fallback block), scores table.
